name: entellix-core
description: Open-source contracts, engine, instructions, and standalone host for Entellix organizational memory.

scripts.check: turbo run typecheck test:unit && pnpm tsdoc:check && oxlint && oxfmt --check
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm release:documentation:verify && pnpm release:topology:verify && pnpm release:packages:verify && pnpm release:standalone:verify && pnpm release:security && pnpm release:secrets && pnpm release:preflight
scripts.release:documentation:verify: node --test scripts/public-documentation.test.mjs scripts/public-governance.test.mjs scripts/standalone-compose.test.mjs scripts/standalone-smoke.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-documentation.mjs
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:preflight && pnpm release:packages:verify && node scripts/release-publish.mjs
